categories.main_business_segments: Jinpu Landscape is a comprehensive landscape enterprise centered on park city construction. The company operates five major business directions: park cities, garden villages, ecological restoration, classical gardens, and smart maintenance. The business covers the full industrial chain of landscape greening, including technology research and development, planning and design, construction, nursery cultivation, and subsequent maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has established integrated operational capabilities spanning technical research and development, planning and design, construction and施工, and nursery cultivation. Core technologies include water system ecological restoration, salt-alkali land improvement, smart landscape management platforms, and classical garden construction techniques. The company employs EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) project delivery models and has developed a 'water, road, green, landscape, city' five-element integrated urban ecological environment improvement operational model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are local governments and government-authorized state-owned entities. The company serves municipal landscape and ecological environment improvement projects across various cities. Major end markets include urban park construction, ecological restoration projects, rural revitalization initiatives, and cultural heritage preservation. Key customers include city development investment companies, county governments, and district management committees.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province and operates across multiple regions including East China (Jiangsu, Anhui), Southwest China (Yunnan, Guangxi), South China (Guangdong), and Central China (Hubei). The company has expanded from its Jiangsu base to over 10 cities across provinces including Yunnan, Guangxi, Guangdong, Anhui, Hubei, Shandong, Henan, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across the full landscape greening industry value chain, functioning as an integrated service provider. It operates midstream (design and planning), downstream (construction and施工), and operates its own nursery operations (upstream苗木 cultivation). The company provides end-to-end solutions from research and development through design, construction, to operations and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing park city construction, promoting ecological restoration technologies, and implementing smart landscape management systems. R&D focuses on water ecosystem restoration, salt-alkali land treatment, drought-resistant ornamental plant breeding, landscape waste utilization, and intelligent irrigation systems. The company established a national postdoctoral research station and research institutes in partnership with leading universities to advance innovation in ecological restoration and smart landscape technologies.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through EPC (Engineering Procurement Construction) project contracts for landscape and ecological environment improvement projects. Revenue is recognized based on project completion progress using the output method. Secondary revenue comes from landscape design services, nursery and building material sales, and property rental income. The company operates on a project-based revenue model with long-term contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The landscape greening industry is highly fragmented with low concentration and no dominant players. The company positions itself as a comprehensive integrated landscape enterprise with competitive advantages in full-chain service capabilities, design-施工 integration, classical garden construction expertise, and cross-regional operations. The company holds numerous industry certifications and awards, including National Forestry Leading Enterprise status and multiple provincial honors, establishing strong brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated operating revenue of approximately 999 million yuan in 2023, representing 2.35% growth from 976 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 3.35 billion yuan at year-end 2023, up 26.59% from 2.64 billion yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders was 21.2 million yuan in 2023, down 71.78% from 75.2 million yuan in 2022, primarily due to increased financial expenses from convertible bond issuance and tax rate changes.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's core differentiation lies in its integrated 'water, road, green, landscape, city' five-element urban ecological environment improvement operational model that systematically addresses urban environmental challenges rather than fragmented approaches. Key value propositions include comprehensive full-chain service capabilities (research-design-construction-operations), strong design-施工 integration enabling cost control and quality assurance, expertise in classical garden and cultural heritage construction, and proven cross-regional operational capabilities. The company emphasizes sustainable development, ecological restoration, and smart management technologies aligned with national carbon neutrality and beautiful China initiatives.
